question: Should Android Sharesheet support be accepted with draft-preserving semantics, or should this feature wait for a different composer replacement UX?
rationale: The repository has no established contract for how a system share should interact with an already-populated composer, and silently replacing user state is not safe to infer.

options.title: Sponsor draft-preserving share import
options.body: Accept the feature after it atomically stages shared content without silent draft loss and includes real-device proof.

options.title: Require replacement confirmation UX
options.body: Accept the feature only with an explicit user prompt before replacing a populated composer.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR until Android share-import product direction is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor draft-preserving share import
recommendation.body: Accept the feature after it atomically stages shared content without silent draft loss and includes real-device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android manifest and build ownership makes this the strongest available routing candidate for accepting the new exported entry point and UX contract.
